These permissions are required for your company check-in. The camera takes the 6 check-in photos, the microphone records the optional voice note, and precise location tags the check-in with your position. Notifications remind you when a check-in is due. Nothing is captured until you start a check-in, and you can decline the photos.
PRF Security needs the camera to take your 6 check-in photos. No photo is taken until you start a check-in.
PRF Security needs the microphone to record the optional voice note that goes with your check-in.
PRF Security tags each check-in with your precise position (map link, geo coordinates and Plus Code). This is stored with the check-in.
PRF Security sends a reminder when a daily check-in is due so you do not miss it.

A link you copied looks unsafe: %1$s\n\nThis is a phishing or malware risk. Do not open it or paste it into a login page. The check is done entirely on your device - no copied text is uploaded anywhere.

PRF Security can check links you copy against a built-in list of known phishing and malware sites. The check happens entirely on this device - no copied text ever leaves your phone, and only the count of warnings is sent with your check-in.
A lookalike domain that imitates a well-known brand. The real site would use its own correct spelling.
A shortened link that hides its real destination.
A raw IP address used in place of a real website domain.
A page that asks for a password, PIN or verification code.
